description.value: Smoke on the Water is a BBQ shack perched on the wharf in Gibsons, BC, where owner Chris Van Nus slow-smokes meats on-site over real hardwood using techniques learned from a World Champion Pit-master in Arkansas. The menu centres on pulled pork, brisket, and heritage chicken sandwiches made with locally sourced ingredients, alongside platters and sides. Primarily a takeout operation with 14 outdoor seats overlooking Gibsons Harbour, it is a compelling fuel stop for cyclists touring the Sunshine Coast.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and provides rich detail. The FAQ explicitly confirms takeout is available ('Yes Everything is designed to take away'), the menu lists a Pulled Jackfruit sandwich and gluten-free tempura batter option confirming vegetarian/vegan/GF items, and the About Us page confirms the business is a primarily takeout BBQ shack with 14 outdoor seats on the Gibsons wharf. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi are mentioned anywhere on the site. Address and phone are confirmed from the contact page: 611 School Rd, Gibsons, BC V0N 1V1 and 604 840 0004.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone; both were sourced from the website contact page only.
OSM tags business as 'fast_food / sandwich' but the website describes it as a gourmet BBQ shack with casual dining — OSM category is an understatement but not a material concern.
Community field lists 'Unknown / Vancouver Island & Gulf Islands' but Gibsons is on the Sunshine Coast mainland, not Vancouver Island or the Gulf Islands.
Bike parking (rack, patio visibility, or staff-approved area) is not mentioned anywhere on the site — this required criterion could not be confirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active BBQ restaurant on the Gibsons wharf with confirmed takeout, outdoor harbour-view seating, and vegetarian/GF options — a clear and useful stop for cyclists touring the Sunshine Coast.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website mentions vacuum-sealing of smoked meats as a travel option ('keep in fridge for a week or freezer for 6 months'), which may be of practical interest to touring cyclists wanting to carry food.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes Pulled Jackfruit sandwich (vegan: jackfruit smoked with alder wood in Kansas City BBQ sauce); Wild Prawn Tacos offered with 'gluten free Tempura Batter' and corn tortilla available on request
